I’m ready to create the SOAP clinical note. Please provide the clinician–patient transcript and the differential diagnosis (DDx) JSON. I will treat the transcript as the primary source and use the DDx to enrich assessments only when consistent.

To help me produce an accurate note, please:

- Paste the full transcript between the markers exactly as in your prompt (<<< transcript >>>).
- Paste the DDx JSON between the markers (<<< ddx >>>).
- Include any missing clinical details you want captured (vitals, exam findings, medications, allergies) if they are not in the transcript.

If you prefer, you can paste both now and I will generate the structured SOAP note following the rules you provided.
